digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation validity / signing / idempotent reuse
propositions: Signed material pins must be validated as the single related-material check across attestation lifecycle, with optional enforcement configurable per VerifyConfig.enforce_plan_material_pins
Pin drift, missing targets, and malformed records invalidate plan-review attestations when enforcement is enabled; disabled enforcement reports these as advisory without changing valid=true
Derived pin health must aggregate target status by severity (malformed-pin > stale-pin-missing > stale-pin-drift > current), with legacy-unpinned for wholly absent pins
Plan validity must support three profiles (DEFAULT, CLOSE, DRIFT_REFRESH) where CLOSE and DRIFT_REFRESH disable only code freshness while retaining signature/registry/own-material/pin checks
Re-sign recovery must validate reviewed_related_material from sidecar records without requiring a certified attestation, preserving the own-material staleness guard
Full LLM reviews must serialize the exact pre-LLM related_material snapshot through sidecar.emit as reviewed_related_material, remaining as optional additive v2 field
